---
title: "State Education Finance and Student Achievement (NAEP, 1992–2015)"
output: github_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(janitor)
library(ggplot2); library(lmtest); library(sandwich); library(car); library(modelsummary)
```

## Data preparation

```{r}
df_raw <- readr::read_csv("data/states_all.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    naep_composite = rowMeans(
      cbind(avg_math_4_score, avg_math_8_score, avg_reading_4_score, avg_reading_8_score),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    # Per-pupil instructional spending
    instr_pp = instruction_expenditure / grades_all_g,
    # Log-transform spending to reduce skew
    log_instr_pp = log(instr_pp),
    # Federal revenue share
    fed_share = federal_revenue / total_revenue
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(naep_composite)) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(log_instr_pp),
    is.finite(fed_share),
    instr_pp > 0,
    fed_share >= 0, fed_share <= 1
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 1992, year <= 2015)
model_df <- df %>%
  select(state, year, naep_composite, log_instr_pp, fed_share) %>%
  drop_na()
nrow(model_df)
```

## Descriptive statistics

```{r}
desc_tbl <- model_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(naep_composite, log_instr_pp, fed_share),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
desc_tbl
# outcome distribution
hist(model_df$naep_composite, breaks = 30, main = "NAEP composite", xlab = "Score")
# spending per pupil distribution (raw vs log)
hist(df$instr_pp, breaks = 30, main = "Instructional $ per pupil (raw)", xlab = "instr_pp")
hist(model_df$log_instr_pp, breaks = 30, main = "log(instr_pp)", xlab = "log_instr_pp")
# federal share
hist(model_df$fed_share, breaks = 30, main = "Federal revenue share", xlab = "fed_share")
cor_mat <- cor(model_df %>% select(naep_composite, log_instr_pp, fed_share),
               use = "complete.obs")
round(cor_mat, 3)
```

## Base model (year fixed effects, HC1 robust SEs)

```{r}
m1 <- lm(naep_composite ~ log_instr_pp + fed_share + factor(year), data = model_df)
summary(m1)
# Robust SE (HC1)
coeftest(m1, vcov. = vcovHC(m1, type = "HC1"))
```

## Assumption diagnostics

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(model_df, aes(x = log_instr_pp, y = naep_composite)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
p1
p2 <- ggplot(model_df, aes(x = fed_share, y = naep_composite)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
p2
plot_df <- tibble(
  fitted = fitted(m1),
  resid  = resid(m1),
  abs_resid = abs(resid(m1))
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fitted, y = resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fitted, y = abs_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
hist(resid(m1), breaks = 30, main = "Residuals", xlab = "Residual")
qqnorm(rstandard(m1)); qqline(rstandard(m1))
```

## Influential observations and corrected model

```{r}
influence_measures <- tibble(
  state = model_df$state,
  year  = model_df$year,
  cooks_d = cooks.distance(m1),
  leverage = hatvalues(m1),
  stud_resid = rstudent(m1)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(cooks_d))
head(influence_measures, 10)
# Rule-of-thumb flags
n <- nrow(model_df)
flagged <- influence_measures %>%
  filter(cooks_d > (4 / n) | abs(stud_resid) > 3)
flagged
if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
  model_df2 <- model_df %>%
    anti_join(flagged %>% select(state, year), by = c("state", "year"))
} else {
  model_df2 <- model_df
}
m1_corr <- lm(naep_composite ~ log_instr_pp + fed_share + factor(year), data = model_df2)
AIC(m1, m1_corr)
summary(m1_corr)
m1_vif <- lm(naep_composite ~ log_instr_pp + fed_share, data = model_df2)
vif(m1_vif)
```

## Moderation: spending × federal share

```{r}
m2 <- lm(naep_composite ~ log_instr_pp * fed_share + factor(year), data = model_df2)
summary(m2)
# Compare base vs interaction (nested F-test)
anova(m1_corr, m2)
# AIC comparison
AIC(m1_corr, m2)
modelsummary(
  list(
    "Base (Year FE)" = m1_corr,
    "Interaction (Year FE)" = m2
  ),
  statistic = "({std.error})",
  stars = TRUE
)
```
